title: User Facing Ui Label Cleanup
description: Clean UI labels to user perspective: engagement options → Commands/toggles, no state machine lingo in user space.
summary: Fixed missing Workbench/Details navbar labels: removed clipping from panel toggle wrappers and ToggleGroup (`overflow-visible` when inline labels present), pass explicit i18n text in platform UIPanelToggleGroup, map playground panel ids to ui.panelToggle.*, fallback panel-kind labels in useControlAccessibleLabel, and added sketchpad panelToggle.details/workbench labels (en/de). Playground navbar uses ui.panelToggle ids. Tests: 107 @ui/react passing including compact navbar panel toggle labels.
